name: Barbell Incline Reverse-Grip Bench Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a 30-to-45-degree incline, sit back with feet flat, and take a wider-than-shoulder underhand grip on the barbell.
Unrack carefully over your upper chest with thumbs wrapped securely and shoulder blades pinned back.
Lower the bar slowly to your upper chest while tucking your elbows tightly along your ribs.
Press the bar smoothly back over your shoulders until your arms extend, then rerack with control.
tips: Always wrap both thumbs securely around the bar for safety with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows close to your torso to protect your wrists and shoulders.
